title: ANU_BUILD_MANIFEST.json
description: Schema for the master execution plan written once at Stage 0 by `python skills/anu-build/build.py init`. This schema documents the artifact that shipped code actually emits; the template it is populated from is skills/anu-build/templates/MANIFEST_TEMPLATE.json. Stage progress is NOT recorded here - it lives in PIPELINE_STATE.json.

schema.description: Identifies the manifest shape this file conforms to.

framework.description: Framework version stamp, e.g. "Anu Framework v12.2".

project.description: Project name, copied from the registry's `project` field.

generated_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of the Stage 0 run that wrote this file.

mode.description: Execution mode the build was initialized in.

series_count.description: Number of entries in the registry's `series` map.

subseries_count.description: Total subseries across all series. Zero for projects whose series declare no subseries.

prefix_scheme.description: Copied verbatim from the registry's `prefix_scheme` when present; omitted or empty otherwise.

stages.description: The canonical 9-stage sequence, Stage 0 through Stage 8. Fixed content: this mirrors skills/anu-build/SKILL.md's Canonical Stage Sequence and is not project-specific.

skill.description: The skill (or `+`-joined skills) that owns the stage.

note.description: Free-text provenance note carried from the template.
